act_ends.title: Act I — The Wake
act_ends.subtitle: Saltmarrow remembers you. Mostly.

recap.text: The Gull's Beacon burns on Saltmarrow's lullaby. Nobody there will ever hum it again.
Pell gave the pebble up, and keeps an empty nest clear without knowing why.
The Gull's Beacon burns on the founding knot. Saltmarrow's nets begin in the middle now, and Hesk has stopped humming.
The Gull's Beacon burns on Mara's memory of her brother. She still sets out two cups.
Brother Aldous told you all he could bear to, and cut the ember from his sleeve.
Brother Aldous gave you the bare fact and nothing more.
Mara knows Dunstan walked into the fog by choice.
You carry a message for him: the stool is still by the door.
Oda Farrow remembers a man called Dunstan. The name will not stay with you.
Pell is crossing with you, with Mara's leave, to coil rope on the Slow Mercy.
You promised Pell a crossing, then took it back.
Pell stays on Saltmarrow, and sent a pouch for something lost and good.
Oda Farrow has seen the Keeper's sleeve-ember in your hand.

act_ends.coda: The Slow Mercy sails for Thornwold on the evening tide. Act II — The Drift — is still being written; every choice you made here will cross with you.
